keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Leon Krekovic (Kauno Zalgiris).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Lugano 1, Kauno Zalgiris 0. Yanis Cimignani (Lugano) left footed shot from very close range to the top right corner. Assisted by Daniel Dos Santos.
Anthony Kalik (Kauno Zalgiris) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Lugano 2, Kauno Zalgiris 0. Ezgjan Alioski (Lugano) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner.
Goal! Lugano 3, Kauno Zalgiris 0. Daniel Dos Santos (Lugano) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Bekhruz Karimov.
